title: CLI is stuck at "0% compiling" for some time

milestone.title: needsTriage
milestone.description: Milestone for all issues that haven't been triaged yet

body:
# 🐞 Bug report ### Command - [x] build - [x] serve ### Is this a regression? Yes, before enabling Ivy it didn't happen. ### Description When running `ng serve` CLI is stuck at "0% compiling" for 1-1.5 minutes. After some investigation I found that it happens because CLI runs `ngcc` processor. We run `ngcc` in post-install script so it's just a waste of time. Is it possible to completely disable ngcc in AngularCompilerPlugin? Below is trace log:
